# ProactiveServiceMigration

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A mechanism where agents anticipate service demand shifts and preemptively relocate service instances across network nodes to optimize latency and energy. Critical for TCC/iNEST convergence, as it allows computational tasks to follow data flows in the network, reducing backhaul and enabling edge-native intelligence.
